messages:
Rachel M: Hey team — draft of the product launch post is live for a quick QA pass + leadflow mapping. Link: https://redwood-inference.notion.site/launch-blog-draft-6a2b

Tyler G: skimmed it. love the flow. landed on the benchmark section — we should be explicit about the exact test harness and hardware. can we add a short note?

Anika S: agreed. add a one-liner: 'Benchmarks measured on g5.12 with stable batching config; see appendix for raw runs.' keeps it digestible.

Rachel M: yes please — add that. Tyler, can you paste the harness link?

Tyler G: yep: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/blob/main/suite/launch_readme.md

James (DevRel): quick note on the narrative: we say "2x faster than X" — legal may want to avoid direct comparisons without source. maybe rephrase to "observed lower median latency vs. comparable open runtimes"

Carlos (Sales Ops): on CTA/leadflow: we need two funnels — "Try hosted" (self-serve) and "Enterprise demo" (sales). need HubSpot form mapping and utm params. Can marketing add hidden fields for ARR band and use-case tag.

Rachel M: good call. propose: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=dedicated_launch. For the two CTAs, map to two forms: form_try_hosted and form_demo_enterprise.

content-bot: Auto-check: images present, meta tags set, alt text missing for fig2. Suggest adding alt: "Throughput and latency comparison"

Anika S: will add alt text. also we should include a 3-sentence webinar teaser under the CTA: date + 30s benefit hook + registration link.

Rachel M: draft teaser: "Join our launch webinar on Apr 28 — we unpack the benchmark methodology and live-demo a production rollout pattern. Seats limited — register now." thoughts?

James (DevRel): sounds good. add a line about live Q&A and example playbook export. that sells the practical takeaways.

Carlos (Sales Ops): on HubSpot mapping — here's the hidden fields snippet, paste into the blog form embed:
```
hubspotFields: {
  hubspot_form_id: "form_try_hosted" || "form_demo_enterprise",
  hidden_fields: {
    utm_campaign: "dedicated_launch",
    arr_band: "${arr_band}",
    product_interest: "inference-hosted"
  }
}
```

Rachel M: perfect. James / Tyler can you confirm the demo form routes to sales queue A? we need SLA on followup within 1 business day.

Tyler G: confirmed — demo form -> Sales Ops queue A (priority). Carlos will validate routing rules.

Carlos (Sales Ops): I will validate and set assignment rules. want to plan a short followup doc for SDRs: what counts as "enterprise demo" lead vs "trial". I'll drop that in the shared folder.

Legal Bot: quick flag: the claim "costs 60% less per token" needs backup. please add reference to our internal cost spreadsheet or soften to "lower per-token costs observed in our tests" until finance approves.

Rachel M: ok we'll soften language for now and add a footnote: "see internal cost appendix (available to partners)". Finance sync next Tue.

Anika S: layout tweak: move the benchmark callout higher — readers should see the headline metric above the fold. also shorten the hero to one sentence.

Rachel M: will send an updated doc in 30 mins with the hero compressed, benchmark callout elevated, alt text added, and CTA mapping included.

James (DevRel): I'll add one example prompt + replay in the appendix so customers can reproduce locally. small code snippet and results graph.

content-bot: Reminder set: publish checklist run at 24 hours before scheduled publish — reactions required from @Legal and @Sales Ops to greenlight lead routing. :alarm_clock:

Rachel M: thanks everyone. tagging @Anika S @Tyler G @Carlos (Sales Ops) for final passes. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll schedule publish for Thu 09:00 PT and a webinar on Apr 28.

Tyler G: thumbs up from me. :thumbsup:

Anika S: OK. will proofread and check CTAs.

Carlos (Sales Ops): will confirm routing rules by EOD.

James (DevRel): fine with webinar details.

Rachel M: final ask — can someone double-check the embed script for tracking so GA sees events for both CTAs? small snippet below: 
```
document.querySelectorAll('.launch-cta').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    gtag('event','cta_click',{event_label: btn.dataset.cta});
  });
});
```

content-bot: Noted. Checklist updated. 

Rachel M: thanks — closing thread when I post the updated draft.
